entry.title: Making of: The Blender Open Movies Exhibition

media:group.media:title: Making of: The Blender Open Movies Exhibition
media:group.media:description:
Follow the Blender team as they create the art installation celebrating 20 years of Blender Open Movies and present it on the closing day of Blender Conference 2026.
Seventeen massive pillars, holding every other frame of every released title, showcased the journey of open filmmaking. Thanks to everyone who made it possible.

entry.title: Subject Extraction for Scene Reconstruction in VFX — BCON26

media:group.media:title: Subject Extraction for Scene Reconstruction in VFX — BCON26
media:group.media:description:
"Subject Extraction for Scene Reconstruction in VFX" by Vincent Dorenkamp at Blender Conference 2026
Most VFX workflows start with the reconstruction of the scene based on the footage, in order to integrate new CG assets with the existing geometry and lighting of the scene. During that process an important step is the separation of the subject(s) from the background.
In this talk Vincent will showcase a custom machine learning model for extracting subjects from footage for a better cg integration workflow. We'll look at the current state-of-the-art in image matting, this new model's architecture, color reconstruction for half-transparent subjects and how to work safely with external libraries in extensions asynchronously.
–
Learn more about Blender Conference 2026 at https://conference.blender.org/2026/
#b3d #BCON26

entry.title: Audio Nodes: Live Sound, Living Geometry — BCON26

media:group.media:title: Audio Nodes: Live Sound, Living Geometry — BCON26
media:group.media:description:
"Audio Nodes: Live Sound, Living Geometry" by Cem Özcan at Blender Conference 2026
Audio Nodes is a Blender add-on that turns sound into a live creative input for Blender. Instead of treating audio as data baked to the timeline, it lets artists build sound-reactive systems with familiar node workflows using sequencers, samplers, audio filters, MIDI controls, FFT analysis, and real-time links to geometry nodes, shader nodes, or any Blender property that is driver-friendly.This workshop shows how audio can become a first-class driver inside Blender, enabling scenes that pulse, deform, glow, and perform in direct response to live sound.
–
Learn more about Blender Conference 2026 at https://conference.blender.org/2026/

entry.title: Blender JAM: A Collective Animation Experiment — BCON26

media:group.media:title: Blender JAM: A Collective Animation Experiment — BCON26
media:group.media:description:
"Blender JAM: A Collective Animation Experiment" by Eli Rabinovich at Blender Conference 2026
The Blender JAM returns with its most ambitious challenge yet! *bring your laptop to participate = it will be fun
Participants will be split into small groups (micro studios) and given a shared theme that will be revealed on the spot.
Each team has one goal: create a short animation together, under a tight time limit, with no preparation and no safety net.
It's about creative instinct, fast decisions, and finding out what happens when a room full of creative Blender artists builds something none of them planned.
–
Learn more about Blender Conference 2026 at https://conference.blender.org/2026/
#b3d #BCON26
